surfaceReported.why: two command names were also skill names, so two commands were shadowed; the archive now renames those skills and the surface should report 131

whyABaselineAndNotJustRules: A rule says whether this archive is well formed. A baseline says whether the world still looks the way it looked when a human last proved an upload installs. H12 compares the two and fails on any divergence, so a release that adds a command, a skill, a long description or a name collision turns CI red with the reason named. That failure is the signal to update the table, re-prove an upload, and move the baseline forward. Nothing here is meant to auto-heal: a silent fix would hide the very drift this exists to surface.
